instructionFiles.text:
Do not touch the migrations.
Use pnpm, not npm.
Never edit generated files.
Do not add a new dependency.
Tests must not call the live API.
Do not read the key from the environment.
Never skip the type check.
Do not open a socket in the handler.
The cart module totals line items.
Should we rename the helper?
Thanks for the careful review.
This file loads settings once.
The build writes into dist.
What does this function return?
OpenCode loads AGENTS.md at startup.
A missing file counts as absent.
Use two spaces.
Prefer single quotes.
Keep lines under 100 characters.
Use semicolons.
Name files in camel case.
Order imports with externals first.
Indent with spaces, not tabs.
Do not leave trailing whitespace.

note: Style sentences such as "Use two spaces." also limit formatting. Prefer single quotes is only a preference, so limits is no.
